question.text: PMs with AUM of Rs. 1,000 crore or more (discretionary + non-discretionary) must have:

answer.text: An automated system with minimal manual intervention for funds/securities management

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI requires automated OMS for such PMs to ensure fairness and audit trails. The Trap: Manual systems scale poorly and invite errors at that AUM. Cross-Exam Context: Similar in III-C Fund Compliance. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Integrate OMS with custodian and back-office for real-time reconciliations.
